items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Then when I went to Minton's we hired Sonny Rollins... we got Sonny Rollins, which we did a lot of recordings with Sonny

ctx.x: So you and Horace and Percy and Milt.
And Bags, yeah. Yeah, that was the quartet. Then when I went to Minton's we hired Sonny Rollins. So I got -- Sonny was hanging around, not doing much.
